dropOffAtTowerB.note: Staff will inspect, weigh, seal, and label your boxes. No refunds if boxes are dropped off after 4 p.m. on May 1.
dropOffAtTowerB.title: Drop-off at Tower B

itemsDamaged.a: Contact UPS immediately. Do NOT discard anything. UPS needs the entire box, label, all contents, all packing materials, and your receipt to process a claim.
itemsDamaged.q: What if my items arrive damaged?

shipWhere.a: CONUS only (excludes PR, Guam, HI, AK).

upsPickup.a: UPS picks up within about 2 business days of drop-off. Tracking info is emailed to you.
upsPickup.q: When does UPS pick up my boxes?

ship2home.paidByCard: Paid by card at pickup. Includes 2 medium boxes (20x20x20 in), packing tape, and UPS ground shipping.
ship2home.pickUpAt: Pick up supplies and drop off at

ship2pitt.amazonNote: Amazon, Target, and other retailer packages are not Ship2Pitt. They go to your building mailroom, not your room.

earlyArrival.note: If you're part of an early arrival group, your boxes will NOT be in your room when you arrive. Do not ship anything you'll need for early arrival (bedding, instruments, medication, etc.)
earlyArrival.title: Early arrival students

ship2pitt.extrasCost: Extras, oversize, overweight, or late shipping billed via PittPay ($30/box for many violations).

boxNotInRoom.a: Check your room thoroughly first. If truly missing, alert your RA and email Ship2Pitt@pitt.edu.

foundBoxes.a: Contact your RA, they'll coordinate pickup with the Ship2Pitt team.

itemsDamaged.a: Take photos immediately. Keep ALL packaging and your receipt. Email Ship2Pitt@pitt.edu. File UPS claim within 30 days.

whenArrive.a: Allow 3 to 5 days after the central facility scan. Boxes shipped after July 22 may go to your mailroom instead of your room.

ship2pitt.onCampusOnly: On-campus residents only · room assignments post July 7

packingTips.fillSpaces: Fill empty spaces so nothing shifts inside
packingTips.newBox: Use a new heavy-duty box, no reused shipping boxes
packingTips.sealTape: Seal with H-tape: one strip along the seam, two across the flap edges

printAtHome.desc: View and print labels to your desktop printer. Attach securely with packing tape.
printAtHome.title: Print at home

printLabels.label: Print your labels
printLabels.note: Have this ready when you open the UPS portal. Each label has a unique tracking number; do not copy one label onto multiple boxes.

qrCode.desc: Get a QR code by email. Bring packages to any UPS Store and they'll label them for you.
qrCode.title: UPS Store QR code

ship2pitt.trackingInfo: UPS tracking numbers start with 1Z97405W. You'll get two emails: one from UPS and one with delivery timing from Ship2Pitt.

augustDelivery.note: You must be present for August delivery. Contact Don Farr in August to schedule your delivery date.
augustDelivery.title: August delivery

pickupInstead.a: Yes. For Dock Dash and On-Campus Drop-Off, you can arrange on-site pickup at the Don Farr dock instead of delivery.
pickupInstead.q: Can I pick up instead of getting delivery?
